description: The training harness's cotter_pin union, reduced to two equal-height unit cylinders: their walls touch along x = y = 0 and each pair of flush rims touches at the end of the ruling (ADR-0088)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE imprints the tangent ruling and shares contact topology between the solids; Arris keeps each cylinder whole and uses disjoint topology
analytic.occt_odd_euler: Open CASCADE shares the imprinted ruling between the cylinders, giving an odd Euler characteristic
analytic.occt_step_counts_differ: The STEP round trip separates the shared contact topology: 6 vertices and 9 edges in the file, where the in-memory result has 4 vertices and 8 edges
